description: This file defines interfaces for shared storage management, including setting, getting, deleting keys and namespaces, storage limits, and cache control within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: ISharedStorage
classes.description: Interface for shared storage operations, including setting, retrieving, deleting values, and event notifications.

classes.name: ISharedStorageInspector
classes.description: Interface for inspecting storage contents, such as keys, namespaces, and sizes.

classes.name: ISharedStorageLimit
classes.description: Interface for managing storage size limits per namespace.

classes.name: ISharedStorageCache
classes.description: Interface for cache management, including flushing the cache.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for storage events.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value for a key within a namespace and scope.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a key within a namespace and scope.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key within a namespace.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves sizes occupied by each namespace.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage size limit for a namespace.
